SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SP. BR. REGISTRY File No. 324 Date August 26, 1940）

Subject G.M. Fedoroff - Antecedents and character.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan.

Georgy Moiseyevich FEDOROFF, Russian, born on 13-9-1897 at Chita, Transbaikal Province, Siberia. He is reported to have served in Admiral Kolchak's army during the civil war in Siberia in 1918-1919, but later to have deserted to the "reds". According to his own statement, he was a member of the Russian communist party for about ten years. During this period he graduated from a Soviet school for political instructors, following which he served in this capacity with various military units stationed in the Maritime Province. In 1929 he appeared in Manchuria declaring that he had been disappointed in the Soviet Rule. He was subsequently employed as a teacher in the Three River Province, Manchuria, for some time, after which he worked as a ticket inspector with the omnibus company at Mukden. Towards the end of 1932 he arrived in Shanghai and has since been residing in this city.

He participated in the activities of the local group of A.A. Vonsiatsky's "All-Russia National-Revolutionary Fascist Party" for a period, after which he was one of the organizers of the "Fatherland Research Society"- an organization ( now defunct ) of pro-fascist tendencies On 6-11-38 he was one of the speakers at a public meeting which was held at the Astor House under the auspices of the Japanese-sponsored Russian newspaper "Russian Voice". 特务科第一股
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科 登记室 档案号 324 日期 1940年8月26日）

事由 G.M. 费多罗夫 - 履历及品行。

由副督察普罗科菲耶夫编制，由副督察洛根转呈。

格奥尔基·莫伊谢耶维奇·费多罗夫（Georgy Moiseyevich FEDOROFF），俄国人，1897年9月13日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省赤塔。据报，他在1918-1919年西伯利亚内战期间曾在高尔察克海军上将的军队中服役，但后来叛逃至“红军”一方。据其本人陈述，他曾是苏联共产党党员约十年。在此期间，他从一所苏维埃政治指导员学校毕业，随后在驻扎于滨海边疆区的各军事单位担任政治指导员。1929年，他出现在满洲，声称对苏维埃统治感到失望。此后，他曾在满洲三江省担任教师一段时间，之后在沈阳的一家公共汽车公司担任查票员。1932年底，他抵达上海，并一直居住在该市。

他曾参与A.A. 冯夏茨基（A.A. Vonsiatsky）领导的“全俄罗斯民族革命法西斯党”当地小组的活动一段时间，之后成为“祖国研究会”的组织者之一——这是一个具有亲法西斯倾向的组织（现已解散）。1938年11月6日，他是日本支持的俄文报纸《俄罗斯之声》（Russian Voice）主办、在礼查饭店举行的一次公开集会的演讲者之一。一度，由于他此前与苏联共产党的关系，当地俄国社区中的右翼分子对他深表怀疑——
